definitions.gloss: ballot counting; vote counting; opening of ballots
definitions.explanation: The process of opening and counting votes after an election.

examples.japanese: {開票|かいひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{開票|かいひょう}⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}ていた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I was watching the vote-counting updates on TV.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{開票|かいひょう}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、ようやく⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確定|かくてい}→確定：13707_kakutei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The ballot-counting work continued until late at night, and the results were finally confirmed.

notes:
Literally 'opening ({開|かい}) ballots (⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧)' — the process of opening ballot boxes and counting votes after an election.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開票|かいひょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to count ballots)
- {開票|かいひょう}⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧ (vote-counting flash report)
- {開票|かいひょう}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (ballot-counting work)
- {開票|かいひょう}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (counting results)
- {開票|かいひょう}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (percentage of ballots counted)
- ⟦{即日|そくじつ}→即日：09661_sokujitsu⟧{開票|かいひょう} (same-day ballot counting)

ELECTION VOCABULARY SERIES:
- ⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧: casting a vote
- {開票|かいひょう}: counting votes
- ⟦{得票|とくひょう}→得票：19111_tokuhyou⟧: votes received (by a candidate)
- ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧: winning an election
- ⟦{落選|らくせん}→落選：07075_rakusen⟧: losing an election
